core_gap.title: No certificate-embedded verifiable PQC migration commitment

evidence.quote: The extensions defined for X.509 v3 certificates provide methods for associating additional attributes with users or public keys and for managing a certification hierarchy.
evidence.relevance: RFC 5280 defines the extension mechanism but no existing extension records a CA migration commitment.
ML-DSA is the target algorithm family for PQCHC commitments; no existing X.509 extension records a CA commitment to migrate to this or any PQC algorithm family.

adjacency_differentiation.overlap: Both concern PQC in X.509 certificates
adjacency_differentiation.differentiation: Composite-sigs defines a new composite signature algorithm. PQCHC is a non-critical extension recording a migration commitment. No signature algorithm is defined or altered.

adjacency_differentiation.overlap: Both concern multi-algorithm aspects of X.509
adjacency_differentiation.differentiation: Multi-auth binding enables simultaneous proof of possession of multiple keys. PQCHC records a CA's future migration schedule. Different problem, different solution.
